title: Accelerating Atomistic-Continuum Simulations of Multilayer 2D Materials with Functional Principal Component Analysis-Based Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.18961v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Atomistic-continuum simulations of complex wrinkling deformations in large-area multilayer two-dimensional (2D) materials are computationally expensive. To accelerate these simulations, this work presents a machine-learning (ML) framework that first constructs a low-dimensional representation of the deformation field, then learns the deformation in this reduced space. Dimensionality reduction of deformed 2D membranes is challenging because of the extremely high dimensionality of discretized deformation fields, the need to preserve surface continuity and prescribed geometric constraints, the stochastic nature of wrinkling patterns, and the limited availability of training data. We address these challenges using two-dimensional functional principal component analysis (FPCA). translated_title: 基于函数主成分分析机器学习加速多层二维材料的原子-连续介质模拟
translated_abstract: 大面积多层二维（2D）材料中复杂褶皱变形的原子-连续介质模拟计算成本高昂。为了加速这些模拟，本工作提出了一个机器学习（ML）框架，该框架首先构建变形场的低维表示，然后在这个降维空间中学习变形。由于离散化变形场的维数极高、需要保持表面连续性和规定的几何约束、褶皱模式的随机性以及训练数据的有限性，变形二维膜的降维面临诸多挑战。我们采用二维函数主成分分析（FPCA）来解决这些挑战。所提出的FPCA表示方法将包含数百万自由度的变形场降维到仅有数十个维度的潜在空间，同时保持（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于二维函数主成分分析（FPCA）的机器学习框架，将多层二维材料的褶皱变形场从数百万自由度降至数十维潜在空间，从而大幅加速原子-连续介质模拟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an FPCA-based machine learning framework that reduces wrinkling deformation fields of multilayer 2D materials from millions of degrees of freedom to tens of latent dimensions, significantly accelerating atomistic-continuum simulations.
